page.overview:
Who is Bera Harkin?

Bera is a stocky Andoran with a square face. She looks like a farmwife with short brown hair and brown eyes, and would have been mistaken for a farmwife if not for her agelessness. Despite this, she has a sternness and strength of character equal to that of her Green colleague Kiruna Nachiman.

She has a One Power strength of , placing her close to the very top of the Aes Sedai hierarchy. Among the rebel faction, only Romanda Cassin and Lelaine Akashi surpass her in strength, and only Sheriam Bayanar and Kiruna Nachiman are her equal., various entries}} She is strong enough to Travel.

She went to the Tower in at the age of 15. After spending only four years as Novice and four as Accepted. During this time, she and Kiruna were pillow friends. Alhough both enjoyed men exclusively later, they remained the very closest of friends.

Bera was raised to the shawl in the year at the age of 23 - an almost unprecedented young age.
